items.item: 2. The breadth of a life's reach after self-concern's definition
items.how: AffectedBy g h := ∃ c, W.DependsOn g c ∧ L.Exchanges h c, and Exchanges is taking from or giving to c while present; the own closure along it from a center is everything that can affect the center at some remove (WithinClosure from the center along AffectedBy; MutuallyDependent is ∀ f g, WithinInfluence f g). So 'what sustains it' (gives to a condition it depends on) and 'what draws on the same conditions' (takes from one) are both in it, as the sentence says. On the English fronts 'Its reach' came right after 'that order already ranks every widening above what it widens' (screen, one page), after a 90-word parenthesis (USES) or after the Lean name (overview, glossary), so 'Its' read as the order's; the Chinese had already named 生命.
